description: Prepare the exact SMS body and eligible audience for host review. Use a separate brief message (usually <=160 characters), not the full email. Host introduction, event link and STOP footer are added automatically. The complete text must fit three SMS segments. Returns body, audienceSize, previewId and expiry; nothing is sent. Show these before send_sms_announcement.

message.description: A brief SMS version, usually at most 160 characters. Do not add the host introduction, event link or STOP footer; the server adds them.

title: Preview Sms Announcement
